source_integrity.summary: Exact v2 pending fingerprint and both source SHA values match producer record; r1 rejection preserved; no previously published public dossier.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: Ready schema 2 research revision 2, strategic-actors editorial kind, global-system-power primary program and EN/PT-BR entries, with frozen taxonomy.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Historical industrial, corporate and administrative chronology uses dated events, 2014 NASA CCtCap awards, January 2 2026 Tesla 2025 production release, and explicitly dated 2025 government administration; observed figures are not silently projected.

factual_methodology.summary: Tesla Investor Relations 2 January 2026 primary release confirms 1,654,667 produced, 1,636,129 delivered and energy storage deployments 46.7 GWh in calendar 2025. NASA September 2014 awards cite potential Boeing $4.2bn and SpaceX $2.6bn values. Production is not sales or profitability; potential contract award is not government cash paid.

evidence_traceability.summary: 16 referenced URL sources in each locale across 11 source hosts. Tesla and NASA critical tables independently verified on directly accessible originals. Corporate, biography, platform governance and administration claims supported by diverse dated documentary and reported sources; not every claim in all 22 narrative sections received individual original-document re-verification.

research_depth.summary: 22 analytic chapters, related-work appendix, bibliographic sources, approximately 4953 EN and 4829 PT-BR substantive words; separates innovation, industrial networks, procurement, ownership, institutional power and criticism.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two analytically meaningful, fully paired graphs: 2025 Tesla cars produced/delivered in millions [1.66,1.64]; NASA CCtCap maximum 2014 award values in US$ billion [4.2,2.6]; comparative tables, structural flow and geographic exposure map in both languages. Corrected Tesla chart attribution to original release.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: 24 headings each, 16 same bibliography URLs, matching quantitative chart series and same three valid internal research links, consistent qualifiers on political association and ownership.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: A prior rejected link to still-unpublished Thiel study is removed from both language editions and factual PayPal relation remains as prose. Yarvin, Land and accelerationism target URLs checked against exact published canonical index; no other broken report hyperlinks detected in narrative. Tesla source credit updated.

contrary_evidence.summary: Commercial revenues, speculative capability and state authority separately analyzed; reported interest in certain political ideas not treated as unified command, and Tesla deliveries are not company profitability.

counterfactual_review.summary: Explicit counterfactual and risk chapter distinguishes technical ability from deployment, economic costs, corporate governance and public oversight.

pipeline_validation.summary: Structural QA checks with matching hashes, charts, internal links, source URL lists, section count and research visual budget passed on parsed staging. Full npm validators and deployment require GitHub Actions after review.

limitations: Source check sampled material critical numerical and political interpretation against primary Tesla and NASA records; complete claim-by-claim audit of all corporate histories not executed.
Canonical report links verified against current repository index as of 4 November 2026, not guaranteed HTTP public availability.
No full local npm run build in QA connector context; required GitHub CI validation after PR.
notes: Revision 2 corrects both exact r1 blockers (unpublished link and Tesla table source attribution) while preserving all supported crosslinks and content. Publisher must preserve source blobs unchanged.
